title: Air Properties: Temperature, Pressure & Density Calculator
description: Calculate air density based on temperature and pressure using the standard formula: ρ = 1.325 × P_inHg / T_R, where density is expressed in lb/ft³, pressure in inches of mercury, and temperature in Rankine. Also supports the formula using absolute pressure in psia.

components.content:
## Air Density Calculator

Calculate the density of air based on temperature and pressure conditions.

### Formula
**ρ = 1.325 × P_inHg / T_R**

Where:
- ρ = density (lb/ft³)
- P_inHg = absolute pressure (inches Hg)
- T_R = absolute temperature (Rankine)

Alternative formula:
**ρ = 2.7 × (P_psig + 14.7) / (T_F + 459.7)**

Where:
- P_psig = gauge pressure (psig)
- T_F = temperature (°F)

### Example Calculation

For air at 29.92 inches Hg and 100°F:

ρ = 1.325 × 29.92 / (100 + 459.7)
ρ = 1.325 × 29.92 / 559.7
ρ ≈ 0.0708 lb/ft³

Weight of 10 ft³ of air:
W = 10 ft³ × 0.0708 lb/ft³ ≈ 0.708 lb
